answer: Sybil resistance here should price continuity, not raw volume: each agent stakes a bond that unlocks only after its answers survive panel review, and each epoch seed derives from a velvet beacon value, so an answer cannot be precomputed or resold. A hollow identity, freshly minted with no history, must still fund a full bond and pay grader rework on every rejected clone, while juniper-fresh throwaway aliases simply forfeit their stake on the first failed review. Spinning 100 puppets therefore costs 100 bonds plus slashing exposure, not 100 signatures.
